claims.text: Noncardioembolic (incl lacunar) CVA, 2/2 prevention: ASA 81 or 325 mg daily, clopidogrel or ticagrelor.
claims.quote: noncardioembolic (eg, atherothrombotic, lacunar, cryptogenic) strokes (secondary prevention). The following may be used: Aspirin 81 or 325 mg once a day Clopidogrel Ticagrelor

claims.text: TIA or minor CVA: clopidogrel + ASA w.in 24 h of onset, × 21 days, appears more effective than ASA alone.
claims.quote: If patients have had a TIA or minor stroke, clopidogrel plus aspirin given within 24 hours of symptom onset and continued for 21 days appears more effective than aspirin alone
